chunks: 1787 - Al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

"When one of you fasts the three days of the month, let him not dispute with anyone, act ignorantly, or hasten to swear and take oaths by Allah. If someone behaves ignorantly toward him, then let him endure it."

key_terms.الثَّلَاثَةَ الْأَيَّامَ: the three days recommended for fasting in the month
key_terms.فَلْيَحْتَمِلْ: let him bear it with patience and forbearance

ai.seo_question: What manners should a person observe while fasting the three recommended days of the month?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the etiquette of observing the recommended three fasts of each month. Along with refraining from food and drink, the fasting person is instructed to avoid disputation, ignorant behavior, and excessive swearing, and to respond to provocation with forbearance.
